items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves

Measure vibrations level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value

Check discharge quantity and pressure
 and compare it with the setting value

Check Any Leakage From Pump& Piping flanges and re-tight 
 (if it is needed)
Check mechanical seal for leakage and re-adjust (if it is needed).

Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting values and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and 
 determine what to be done (if it is needed)

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)

Check bolts fixation then 
 re-tighten it (if it is needed)

Clean external part with compressed 
 air

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which 
 must be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
This pump is used for transfer 
 raw water to cool main condenser of unit
Technical Specifications:
Quantity | 5
Type | Vertical Centrifugal Pump
Number 
 of Stages | 1
Speed | 495 clockwise
Flow | 19800 m3/hr
Discharge Head | 1.7 bar
Original 
 Lubricant | ISO VG 46
Total Quantity 
 of Lubricant | 13 L

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Straight edge, rugs, cleaning 
 fluid.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value
Check discharge quantity and pressure
 and compare it with the setting value
Check Any Leakage From Pump& Piping flanges and re-tight 
 (if it is needed)
Measuring bearing temperature
Check mechanical seal for leakage and re-adjust (if it is needed).
Pump out of 
Operation
Replace the pump oil
Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting values and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and 
 determine what to be done (if it is needed)
Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)
Check bolts fixation then 
 re-tighten it (if it is needed)
Clean external part with compressed 
 air
